requirements.title: IEEE_NEXT_UP returns the adjacent higher representable value
requirements.definition: For non-NaN values other than positive infinity, the result is the least representable value that compares greater than X.

pending.IEEE_NEXT_UP-result-greater-than-finite-: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) for IEEE_NEXT_UP and IEEE_NEXT_DOWN; datatype-supported branch uses X=2.0 and asserts IEEE_NEXT_UP(X)>X and IEEE_NEXT_DOWN(IEEE_NEXT_UP(X))==X; unsupported branch skips. Mutate the operation direction so the relation fails.
pending.IEEE_NEXT_UP-negative-zero-higher-neighb: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) for IEEE_NEXT_UP, IEEE_COPY_SIGN, and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE plus IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL(X); supported branch constructs NZ=IEEE_COPY_SIGN(0.0,-1.0), pre-verifies IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(NZ), evaluates IEEE_NEXT_UP(NZ), computes the least positive subnormal from MINEXPONENT(X) and DIGITS(X) as a power of two with exponent MINEXPONENT(X)-DIGITS(X), hand-checks exact representability, and asserts result equals that value, result>0.0, and result/=0.0; unsupported branch skips the subnormal-specific assertion.
pending.IEEE_NEXT_UP-HUGE-result-positive-infini: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) for IEEE_NEXT_UP and IEEE_CLASS plus IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(X); supported branch uses X=HUGE(X), evaluates IEEE_NEXT_UP(X), and asserts IEEE_CLASS(result)==IEEE_POSITIVE_INF without expecting IEEE_OVERFLOW; unsupported branches skip.
